purpose: Manual privacy corrections discovered during exhaustive post-index audit of !Compliance.zip.
rule: These sources are restricted metadata-only regardless of the initial deterministic manifest flag. Do not commit row-level content, OCR, person names, addresses, identifiers, demographic attributes, payroll values, or applicant decisions.

overrides.reason: Master applicant-tracking workbook is inherently person-level.
Payroll/EEO-1 supporting worksheet is person-level compensation/workforce data.
EEO-1 employee list is person-level workforce/demographic data.

audit_note: Blank applicant/self-identification forms, blank complaint/investigation forms, aggregate termination summaries, and general accommodation policies/templates remain safe when they contain no completed person-level data.
